name: Sami
source:
A stoic man whose expressions often don't match his words, making him difficult to read.

He's very good at his job but doesn't feel much for it and considers it a necessary evil to fuel his fandom addiction.

Likes: Energy drinks, rewatching his favorite shows
Dislikes: Losing

"I'm good at gaming for days without sleep. And verbally destroying teenagers on the internet. I am, as the kids say... chronically online."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048330/Mirage_Noir/]Steam[/url]]
